title: Music and Dance in Xhosa Culture - BeingAfrican
text: February 27, 2024 - Another popular Xhosa song is “uQongqothwane,” also known as “The Click Song” by Miriam Makeba. It was released in 1960. uQongqothwane is a traditional wedding song about uQongqothwane (knocking beetle) that bringsgood blessings to those getting married. Various musical instruments are used in the Xhosa culture, with “Umrhubhe” and Uhadi” being the two fundamental sounds in Xhosa music.

text: July 26, 1999 - Spoken by various ethnic groups, Niger-Congo languages reflect the cultural diversity of the continent. They have shaped musical traditions, with time-line patterns and rhythmic structures integral to many forms of dance music. Oral traditions, including praise poetry, are also closely tied to these languages.
